text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
It's been several days since {0} transferred into
Lucent Academy. Another day, another class with Io.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}が転入してから数日……
きょうもイオの授業を受けていた。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Okay everyone, time's almost up.
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんな、
そろそろ問題解き終わるかな？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Oh, {0}. You haven't made much progress.
You look a little flushed, too. Are you feeling okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら？
{0}君、
あんまり進んでないわね？
なんだか顔も赤いし……
体調でも悪いの？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Let me check your temperature.
I'll just put my forehead to yours, and...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっと体温測るわね？
おでこ貸して……

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, whoa! Io!
No taking temperature by touching foreheads.
You're way too close to him!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょちょちょっと！　
イオちゃん！
おでことおでこ、
くっつけるとか……！
距離が近すぎるわよ！

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text: No fair trying to seduce him! That's playing dirty!
text_block_list.orig_text:
色仕掛けなんて、
卑怯よ！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Seduce? Dirty?
What're you talking about?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
色仕掛け……？
なんの話？

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text:
You mean you're actually oblivious?
Unreal. She's invincible...
text_block_list.orig_text:
天然でやってるの？
なによそれ、
最強じゃない……

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What?
Did I do something wrong?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
え？
私、
なにか悪いことしちゃった……？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
I dunno, but that big brain of his isn't gonna be getting
enough blood to be able to focus on his work with you all
nuzzled up on him like that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん～？　
よくわかんないけど、
そんなに近づいたら、
ヒデサイも集中できないっしょ？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: No? I was just trying to check if he had a fever.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そうなの？
私はただ、
熱がないか調べようと思って……

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Io, real talk. You're like, legit defenseless.
When you lean over with that wide-open top on,
everyone can see like, everything.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちゃんイオは、
ちょっと無防備すぎるんだよね。
そんなに胸元の開いた服着てるんだから、
前かがみになったら、
見えちゃうっしょ？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
H-huuuh?! You can see them?
Oh, geez, I'm so embarrassed!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
ええ！？
見えちゃってたの……！？
は、
恥ずかしい……

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
But normal clothes are so tight in the chest,
it hurts to wear them...
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
普通の服だと、
胸が苦しくて着られないし……

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text:
Are you freaking kidding? What's your problem?!
You trying to pick a fight with me?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
嫌味！？　
嫌味なの！？
アタシにケンカ売ってるわけ！？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
No! Misaki, why are you getting mad at me?
It's the truth. I was just trying to explain myself.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ！？
なんでミサキちゃんが怒るの？
私は本当のこと言っただけなのに……

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text:
You [i]are[/i] that oblivious!
A sexy, ditzy, genuinely
nice teacher. What an opponent…
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっぱり天然っ！
て、
天然お色気教師……
恐るべし……

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Okay, settle down, Misaki.
You'll develop sooner or later.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まぁまぁミサキっち、
落ち着いて。
そのうち大きくなるって。

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Anyways, Io, with you next to him, whiz-boy can't concentrate.
I don't mind teaching him, though!
text_block_list.orig_text:
とりあえず、
ちゃんイオがそばにいたら
ヒデサイも集中できないし、
うちが勉強教えてあげても、
いいけど？

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text:
Ha! Nice try, Suzuna!
If she's tutoring you, so am I.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ！　
スズナだけズルいわよ！
スズナがやるなら、
アタシだって
{0}に教えるわ！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Umm. I don't know...
Do you two really think you can teach?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっと……
その……
二人とも、
ちゃんと教えられるの？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Totally! We got this. I'll go first!
All right, I'll teach you your times tables.
Repeat after me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
よゆー！
じゃあ、
まずはうちからね！
ヒデサイ、
九九教えてあげるよ！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: One times one is seven...
text_block_list.orig_text: いんいちがしち……

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: You got the very first one wrong!
text_block_list.orig_text: 最初の最初でまちがえてるわよ！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
I-I just got a little tongue-tied is all. But if I just change
to start from the sevens row, it works, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
こ、
このくらい、
ちょっとした間違いだし。
七の段で調整すれば、
大丈夫っしょ？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: No, it's still wrong!
text_block_list.orig_text: 調整してもダメ！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Listen whiz-boy, when it comes to multiplication,
you gotta watch out for that sevens row!
It's devil emoji hard!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヒデサイ、
九九で注意しないといけないのは
七の段だから！
七の段からおにムズだからね！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
It's like, the last boss of the times tables.
But once you whoop that bad dude, you've basically
got the whole thing mastered!
text_block_list.orig_text:
九九の中ではラスボスみたいなもんかな。
七の段を倒せたら、
九九は制覇したようなもんだよね！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Traditionally, we teach multiplication tables up to twelve...
text_block_list.orig_text:
九九なんだから、
八の段と九の段も
忘れちゃダメよ……

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Aww, man. Dude, seven is hard enough. Eight and nine are like,
impossible! I still don't really get them.
text_block_list.orig_text:
え～！
だって８とか９って、
もうおにムズすぎて、
うちもよくわかってないし。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Then you can't teach them.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあ、
教えられないじゃない～

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's right, {0}.
If you use that variable, the odds increase.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……そうそう。
{0}、
そこはちゃんと引かないとダメよ。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Oh, Misaki, are you teaching {0} statistics?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら、
ミサキちゃん。
{0}君に数学を教えているの？

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text:
Nah.
I'm educating him on an extracurricular subject.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ううん。
アタシがしているのは、
特別な授業。

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text: Strategies for romance!
text_block_list.orig_text: 恋の駆け引きについてよ！

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text:
You listening? Like I was saying, you have to vary your
approach and avoid laying it on thick every time.
That's the way to increase your odds!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いい？
押すだけじゃダメなのよ。
たまには引かないといけないの！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: That subject's not in the curriculum.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それ、
学校で教えることじゃないわよ……？

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text:
B-but I'm not good enough at any subject to be able to tutor
people.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だ、
だって……
アタシ、
人に教えられるほど、
得意な教科ないのよ。

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text:
But it was still useful, right {0}?
You got something out of it, didn't you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
ためになったはずよ！
そうでしょ、{0}？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
I want a review, too!
What'd you think of my times table lesson?
choice_data_list: None of it made any sense.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
うちも感想聞きたい！
ヒデサイ、
うちの九九の話、
どうだった？

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text:
Why're you looking off to the side?
You're totally lying.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんで目、
そらすのよ！
絶対にウソでしょ！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
I see...
Guess teaching's harder than it looks.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そっか～
やっぱり人に教えるのって
ムズぃね？

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text:
Rats.
I guess we've gotta give up for today.
Io, we'll leave the teaching to you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……仕方ないわね。
きょうのところは、
諦めるわ。
{0}は、
先生が教えてあげて。

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's for the best. It'd be cool if I was
smart enough to tutor you someday though, whiz-boy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
やっぱそれがいいっしょ。
……でも、
いつかヒデサイに教えてあげたいな～

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text:
It would be cool. We'll have to study extra hard if we're gonna
make that happen!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうね……
そのためには、
アタシたちもしっかり勉強しないと。

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Makes sense. You gotta study lots and lots if you're gonna
teach other people. All right, let's do our best, Misaki!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そっか。
人に教えるなら、
もっと勉強しないとダメだよね。
よ～し、
ミサキっち、
勉強がんばろ～！

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text:
Right!
I'll study like no one's ever studied before!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もちろんよ！
アタシの方ががんばるんだから！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Aww. Look at how motivated they are now.
I'm so happy to see them excited to learn.
This is all thanks to you, {0}.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
二人ともあんなにやる気出して……
勉強がんばってくれて、
私もうれしいわ。
{0}君のおかげね？

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Io smiled warmly at the sight of Suzuna and Misaki
with their noses buried in their textbooks.
text_block_list.orig_text:
一生懸命に教科書を読む二人の姿に、
優しく微笑むイオであった。
